name: HOLD FAST
description:
WHEN: Your Fight phase.

TARGET: One ASHEN WARDENS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the hit roll.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem on a unit that made a charge move this turn.

name: COVERING VOLLEY
description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge.

TARGET: One ASHEN WARDENS unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.

EFFECT: Your unit can shoot at the charging unit as if it were your Shooting phase.

name: SURGE OF THORNS
description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One VERDANT SWARM unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

name: RE-ROLL DICE
description:
WHEN: Any phase, just after you make a roll.

EFFECT: Re-roll that roll.
